description: The income lever in a stall (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_income.c; research/notes/modules/income-lever.md): Town & Country at Hard, seat 0 an idle human (ARM), seats 1 and 2 CORE with the AI off, a base energy storage of 10 and nothing stored, and an Automatic Radar Targeting each (CORTARG, EnergyUse 1300). Seat 1 has one solar collector beside its commander, 45 energy a pass, and the `income-stall` test group's content arms it at x5 (tools/impai/level_lever.py --income 1=5); seat 2 has ten, 225 a pass of its own. Both stall on the same demand at the same rate, and tools/impai/income_check.py stall asserts from GameTime 330 that seat 1 spends its bonus as seat 2 spends its production; a bonus credited after the pass would be clamped to the storage of 10 and wasted. The seats with the AI off have no takeover test: a takeover seats them as computer players again.
